# Capsule CRM

Capsule CRM is a simple yet powerful CRM platform designed to help businesses manage customer relationships, sales pipelines, and tasks efficiently.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/capsule-crm/.

## Actions

- **Create Capsule CRM Party**: Create a party in capsule crm.
- **List Parties** (read-only): List all parties (contacts) on the account.
- **Delete Party**: Fully delete a specific party (person or organisation) from capsule crm.
- **List Deleted Opportunities**: List opportunities deleted or restricted since a given date.
- **List deleted parties**: Retrieve parties deleted since a given date.
- **List Entries By Date**: List notes, emails, and completed party tasks in descending order by entry date.
- **List Organisation Employees**: List employees linked to a specific organisation (party).
- **List Projects**: List projects (cases) from capsule crm.
- **List Tasks**: List tasks on the capsule account.
- **List Users**: List all users on the capsule account.
- **Run Filter Query**: Run structured filter queries on parties, opportunities or kases.
- **Update Capsule CRM Party**: Update an existing person or organisation (party) in capsule crm.
